Albany International: Keeps SLC Facility; Extends Sikorsky Contract

: Albany International (AIN) will keep its Amelia Earhart Drive facility in Salt Lake City and extended its Sikorsky CH-53K contract to improve program finances, cut risk and preserve the customer tie.

: Albany International (AIN): CFO Willard Station on medical leave; Controller and Chief Accounting Officer Sean Valashinas named acting CFO effective immediately.
